description: This source file defines the ParagraphFormat class in the MigraDoc library, representing the formatting options for a paragraph such as alignment, indentation, spacing, borders, shading, and tab stops. It includes methods for cloning, serializing, and managing formatting properties and collections related to paragraph formatting.

classes.name: ParagraphFormat
classes.description: Represents the formatting configuration for a paragraph, including alignment, indentation, spacing, borders, shading, tab stops, and related properties.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ParagraphFormat object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the object, including nested formatting objects.

methods.name: AddTabStop
methods.description: Adds a tab stop at the specified position.

methods.name: AddTabStop
methods.description: Adds a tab stop with specified alignment and leader.

methods.name: RemoveTabStop
methods.description: Removes a tab stop at the specified position.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a TabStop object to the collection.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all tab stops from the collection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the ParagraphFormat into DDL format.
